Every breakfast across our 9 days is included, cooked in the lodges where we wake.

On Day 4, the morning starts in San Gerardo de Dota before the 25 kilometres of the Queen Stage. The route drops 2,351 metres down the Savegre valley to Ranchos Tinamú. Along the way, mountain families open their kitchen doors to our runners with hot coffee, agua dulce, fruit, and fresh empanadas.

We travel with 6 to 8 athletes. That group size means every meal has an origin we can name, and every evening finishes at one long table together.

The Trail Running Expedition: 5 – 13 December 2026, 20 – 28 February 2027, 7 – 15 August 2027. Details in the bio.
